messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning a managed path swap tonight 22:30 UTC. Goal: move /v1/generate traffic to new pool (commit ab12f3) with session pinning preserved. Change window 30m. Canary ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Readiness gates: error-rate delta < 1.5% and p95 latency delta < 120ms at each step. I'll kick off and monitor. ping @ops-oncall if anything spikes.
anya: Do we need to drain KV cache or keep cache affinity? Sessions use sticky cookie; router supports affinity by route-key. We should avoid full cache flush.
cheng: Router command I'll run for the swap (will paste logs):
```
routerctl apply --route /v1/generate --target pool-new --staged-ramp 5,25,50,100 --pin-sessions true
``` 
cheng: Also setting pinning TTL to 12h so users don't jump mid-swap.
deploy-bot: Automated rollout scheduled by sam at 22:30 UTC. Steps: 5% at +0m, 25% at +5m, 50% at +12m, 100% at +25m. Health probe: /healthz (200 + latency) every 15s. Alert if errors > 1.5% over baseline for 2 consecutive probes.
raul: Please confirm previous deploy (ab12f3) passed preflight e2e suite. I saw a flaky embedding test last week.
sam: ab12f3 passed smoke and perf locally. e2e passed in staging at 2pm. embedding flake was unrelated (timeout on download). We'll keep an eye.
olivia: Heads-up: cache keys for rerank service will be regenerated on new binary. Small spike in compute expected during first 10 minutes. Recommend leaving 5% longer if we see >10% CPU increase.
ops-oncall: I'll be on watch at 22:25–23:00. If deploy-bot hits an alert, I'll post to #incidents and start rollback checklist.
cheng: Starting rollout in 5mins. First step will be 5% — I'll watch p95, error-rate, and 5xx count.
deploy-bot: Starting ramp: 5% -> pool-new. (audit-id: rollout-1938765432-a)
sam: Monitoring dashboards now. p95 is +10ms at 5% so far, errors flat. :thumbsup:
anya: Session stickiness looked good on a quick sample of users. No 302s or cookie churn.
olivia: CPU +8% on pool-new workers; within expected. Keep moving.
raul: Increasing to 25% OK from my side.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% complete. (audit-id: rollout-1938765432-b)
sam: p95 +18ms, error-rate delta +0.6% — within gate. Proceed.
cheng: Moving to 50% now. Running routerctl: `routerctl stage --percent 50 --id rollout-1938765432-c`
deploy-bot: 50% stage started.
ops-oncall: Noting a small surge in 429s from one edge region (eu-west-1). Investigating network queueing at edge LB.
sam: Pause ramp. Hold at 50%. tagging: #incidents for region-eu-west-1. cheng, can you pin traffic away from that edge POP while we triage?
cheng: Routing rule updated to avoid eu-west-1 POP for new pool. `routerctl pop exclude eu-west-1 --id rollout-1938765432-c` — done.
olivia: After excluding pop, 429s dropped. p95 stabilized. Recommend resume to 100%.
raul: Agree. No backend errors, only edge queueing.
deploy-bot: Resuming ramp to 100%.
sam: Proceeding to 100%. If error-rate delta > 1.5% or p95 delta > 120ms, we rollback immediately. Rollback command (if needed):
```
routerctl rollback --id rollout-1938765432 --to pool-old
``` 
deploy-bot: Traffic at 100% on pool-new. Draining pool-old with connection-timeout 60s. (audit-id: rollout-1938765432-final)
ops-oncall: Observed short-lived spike in token service latency for 60s at final step, then returned to baseline. No user-facing errors.
sam: Cool. Leaving rolling update notes in release doc. Will pin release version in manifest: `release: v2026-03-20-ab12f3` and schedule post-deploy smoke in 1h.
anya: Quick reminder to update the canary tag in the console (so internal QA can reference pool-new). Also adding a tiny eval to check rerank quality.
cheng: All done. Router config saved and rolled to gitops. :white_check_mark:
raul: LGTM, adding a short postmortem blurb for embedded flake monitoring.
olivia: Marking cost note: pool-new uses slightly different instance types — watch OPEX for next billing cycle.
sam: Thanks everyone. Closing the swap thread. If we see anything odd overnight I'll reopen. :slightly_smiling_face:
